fields.summary_ko.0: STX stock rose 3.8%, rebounding on undervaluation buying after plunging from the 52-week high of $1,145, with sentiment improvement driven by no corporate disclosure.
fields.summary_ko.1: STX fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $4.23 billion, up 63% year-over-year, supported by increased data center demand driven by expansion of Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording (HAMR) technology.
fields.summary_ko.2: UBS pushed back the timing of HAMR reaching its $1 billion target to 2028 but maintained a positive stance, while Baird raised its price target from $1,080 to $1,350.
